nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $g \ne 0$ a polynomial over $F$ of degree $r$. For every message polynomial $m$ over $F$ and every natural number $i$, the coefficient of $X^{i+r}$ in the CRC encoding of $m$ with generator $g$ equals the coefficient of $X^i$ in $m$.
nodes.title: CRC encoding is systematic

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $g$ be a polynomial over $F$ with at least two nonzero coefficients that is not divisible by $X$, let $m$ be a polynomial over $F$, and let $c$ be the CRC encoding of $m$ with generator $g$. Then $g$ does not divide $c + aX^i$ for any nonzero $a \in F$ and any natural number $i$, and $g$ does not divide $c + e$ for any polynomial $e$ over $F$ that is a burst of length at most $\deg g$. That…
nodes.title: CRC error-detection guarantee

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $g$, $m$ and $e$ be polynomials over $F$, and let $c$ be the CRC encoding of $m$ with generator $g$. Then $g$ divides $c + e$ if and only if $g$ divides $e$: a codeword plus an error pattern passes the check exactly when $g$ divides the error.
nodes.title: CRC detection criterion

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field. For all polynomials $g$ and $m$ over $F$, the polynomial $g$ divides the CRC encoding of $m$ with generator $g$.
nodes.title: CRC codewords are multiples of the generator

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field of characteristic 2 (for example $\mathbb{F}_2$), let $g$ and $m$ be polynomials over $F$, and let $r$ be the degree of $g$ (with $r = 0$ when $g = 0$). Then the CRC encoding of $m$ with generator $g$ equals $m X^r + (m X^r \bmod g)$: the encoder appends the remainder to the shifted message.
nodes.title: CRC encoding in characteristic 2

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $g$ be a polynomial over $F$ (the generator), and let $r$ be the degree of $g$ (with $r = 0$ when $g = 0$). The CRC encoding of a polynomial $m$ over $F$ (the message) is $m X^r - (m X^r \bmod g)$: the message shifted up by $r$ positions, minus the remainder of the shifted message modulo $g$.
nodes.title: CRC encoder

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $e \ne 0$ be a polynomial over $F$, and let $i$ and $L$ be natural numbers. If every $j$ for which the coefficient of $X^j$ in $e$ is nonzero satisfies $i \le j < i + L$, then $e$ is a burst of length at most $L$.
nodes.title: Errors confined to a window are bursts

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $L$ a natural number. A polynomial $e$ over $F$ is a burst of length at most $L$ when $e = X^i b$ for some natural number $i$ and some polynomial $b$ over $F$ with $b(0) \ne 0$ and $\deg b < L$. Then the nonzero coefficients of $e$ lie in positions $i, \dots, i + L - 1$, the first one nonzero.
nodes.title: Burst errors

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $g$ a polynomial over $F$ with at least two nonzero coefficients. Then $g$ does not divide $a X^i$ for any nonzero $a \in F$ and any natural number $i$.
nodes.title: Single-symbol errors are detected

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $g$ be a polynomial over $F$ that is not divisible by $X$, and let $L$ be a natural number with $L \le \deg g$. If a polynomial $e$ over $F$ is a burst of length at most $L$, then $g$ does not divide $e$.
nodes.title: Short bursts are detected

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
